question.html:
The diagram below shows two particles travelling in opposite directions above the ground.

The velocity with respect to the ground of particle A is 0.6 and the velocity of particle B with respect to the ground is –0.75.

a Calculate the velocity of particle B according to particle A. [2]

b Show that the particles are not emitted simultaneously in the frame of observer Y, according to the Lorentz transformation equations. [2]
